files.lastDescription: R5 acceptance 'Parts that are not shown are loaded when needed rather than up front, so the initial view does not carry them' has no test that can fail: the new code-splitting of GitDrawer/ConsoleNav/EditPane/ThemeFinder/CommandPalette is u

The plan puts the branch popover in both the panel (P9) and dialog (D10) inventories, and the R1 test cannot notice a part appearing more than once, so the 'exactly one place' acceptance is both unproven and currently false.
